Birds can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] from [[Turael]] or [[Spria]]. They have no requirements to be assigned and are generally meant as tasks for beginners. There are a wide variety of birds, but the most commonly killed are [[chicken]]s, [[seagull]]s and [[duck]]s, which are low-level, rarely deal damage and easy to access. Chickens drop [[bones]], [[raw chicken]] and [[feathers]], but most other birds only drop [[bones]] or nothing at all, meaning there is little reason to slay higher-level birds.

Birds introduced with the [[Sailing]] skill do not reward Slayer experience and thus do not count towards task completion.
